msg: Hi. We want to complete our PADI open water: we have referrals and e-learning certificates. We would also like a refresher first. How does the 2 day open water referral course cost plus a mini course the day before. 2 persons. Thanks
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. So happy to have you here! I'd love to help you put your plan together. 🌊

That sounds like a great plan! Since you’ve completed the theory and pool sessions, the *Open Water Referral Course* is the right option. You’ll need to bring your referral paperwork signed by a PADI instructor.

The refresher includes pool practice and one ocean dive; the referral course includes four certification dives. Both include equipment and boat transport. You’ll need to stay overnight on the islands during the referral course, and accommodation isn’t included.

The referral course requires the PADI referral form signed by your original instructor; this is the “Open Water Referral Course,” not a regular dive trip.

A refresher is normally required if it’s been more than two years since your last dive. It’s for already-certified divers; the mini course for people who aren’t certified is an introductory try-dive and doesn’t count toward certification. I don’t have the scheduling detail handy to confirm whether the refresher can be arranged the day before the referral course.

To give you the exact price I need to know where you're starting from: would you leave *from Cartagena* or are you already *on the Rosario Islands*? Plans and prices change depending on the departure point. 🌊

msg: Ok. Thanks. We will work out the best days. Do you recommend any hotels on the island convenient for the diving?
reply:
Absolutely! For the most convenient access to diving, I’d recommend *Hotel San Pedro de Majagua* or *Hotel Cocoliso* on Isla Grande—our dive base is at both, and pick-up is direct.

Other nearby hotels with maritime access include *Rosario de Mar, Secreto, Ubuntu, Mulata, Eco Hotel Las Palmeras, and Pao Pao*. Pick-up can be arranged from these too, depending on boat access; sometimes the meeting point is a nearby dock. Accommodation isn’t included in the dive plans, so you’d book directly with the hotel.

Have you narrowed down which part of Isla Grande you’d like to stay in?

Since you’ll be staying on the islands, the refresher is booked as *“Dive Mini Course (already on the islands)”*. The online price is *USD 134 per person*—not $50—and it includes equipment and hotel pick-up if your hotel has boat access; lunch isn’t included.

Book and pay online here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/dive-mini-course-already-on-island/20?language=en

The refresher is for certified divers who haven’t dived in more than two years. Would you like help finding the booking link for your Open Water Referral Course too?
